# Hunspell suggestion capture on the external Wikipedia set (SPEC §19.4),
# generated once with a throwaway CLI compiled from scriba's vendored
# hunspell 1.7.2 (source + binary kept in bench/tools/hunspell_cli/) against the bundled
# en_US.aff + en_US.dic (SCOWL-derived, same family as stoppard's en-US.txt).
# Input: tests/data/spelling_wikipedia.txt (3382 pairs, disjoint from the
# 419-word reference set). Format: word | sugg1 sugg2 ... in hunspell's
# ranking order; words hunspell considers correct (spell() == true) are
# omitted.
#
# M11 comparison — stoppard vs hunspell top-1 / top-5, by intended edit
# distance (stoppard was tuned on the reference set; this set is held out
# from all tuning):
#
#   distance     n    stoppard top-1  top-5    hunspell top-1  top-5    delta top-1
#   -------   ----   --------------  -----    --------------  -----    ----------
   d1     2492        92.8%    99.9%        84.6%    96.7%      +8.2pp
   d2      812        81.2%    95.4%        83.5%    91.4%      -2.3pp
   d3       60        33.3%    65.0%        45.0%    61.7%     -11.7pp
   d4       12        33.3%    50.0%        41.7%    50.0%      -8.3pp
   d5+       6         0.0%     0.0%         0.0%    16.7%      +0.0pp
   total  3382        88.6%    97.8%        83.4%    94.5%      +5.2pp
#
# Rows above are the M11 capture. After the "-ally" ranking rules (variant M,
# then M2 pool-wide, 2026-08-03) and keeping hunspell's first below--100 ngram
# guess even when the pool is not empty, the full-set totals moved to 3011
# top-1 (89.0%) / 3314 top-5 (98.0%): stoppard vs hunspell +5.6pp top-1.
# Per-distance rows not re-rolled.
# 
# Timings over the same 3382 flagged words (Release build, single-threaded,
# recorded 2026-08-03, engine-only where noted). Both engines spend ~30-45 ms
# per word on this fully-flagged workload (vs ~0.02 ms/word on normal text,
# where suggestions are skipped); treated as constants for the record —
# hunspell is not vendored in this repo, so only stoppard can be re-timed
# in-tree (SpellingParity.DumpMissed prints elapsed_ms for the check loop):
#
#   stoppard (engine loop, elapsed_ms from DumpMissed)   ~100 s   (100.1 s wall incl. test run)
#   hunspell (whole CLI, GNU time user)                  143.5 s  (148.8 s wall)
#
# So stoppard runs the same 3382 suggestions in ~70% of hunspell's time.
